penalties.authority: Adjudicating Officer & Registrar of Companies, NCT of Delhi and Haryana
penalties.details: Adjudicating Officer (AO) on the basis of power vested to him pursuant to section 454(1) passed an order against the Sandhar Han Shin Auto Technologies Private Limited and its Directors, (Joint Venture Company of Sandhar Technologies Limited )for the violation of section 90 of the Companies Act, 2013. Further, one of the current Director of JV Company is also a KMP of the Sandhar and AO has imposed a penalty of INR 50,000/- against him for the violation of section 90 of the Companies Act, 2013. On 19 Dec 2025 director of the Company has received an order from the office of AO for the violation of section 90 of the Companies Act, 2013. Further as per the infromation received from the director, he wishes to file an appeal before the Officer of Hob'ble Regional Director (NR) against the order of AO. So, pursuant to sub-para 20 of para A of Part A of Schedule III, we are providing the details for the same.
penalties.impact: No impact on financial, operation or other activities of the Company.
